segments.narration: Own physical silver tax-sheltered retirement savings with up to $8,0,0000. A silver IRA is a self-directed individual retirement account that holds physical silver instead of stocks or mutual funds.
The IRS requires a minimum purity of .999 fine silver for IRA-held metal.
The silver market ran a supply deficit for a fifth consecutive year in 2025, meaning global demand exceeded mine output again (Source: Silver Institute).
That structural imbalance pushed the annual average silver price to record highs in 2025 (Source: Silver Institute).
Global demand for silver coins and net bars rose in 2025 after two consecutive years of decline, signaling a shift back toward physical metal ownership (Source: Silver Institute).

Equity Trust, one of the largest self-directed IRA custodians in the country, holds billions in precious metals across its accounts as of Q1 2026 (Source: Goldiew, Equity Trust Company Review, May 2026).
A rollover moves funds from an existing 401(k) or workplace plan.
